rationale: Figure 2 visibly shows the molecule and protein source objects entering dedicated encoders and an adaptor into BioMedGPT-LM, plus immediate prompt-based QA interfaces with explicit `<molecule>...</molecule>` and `<protein>...</protein>` forms. That is grounded evidence for the multimodal fine-tuning and molecule/protein QA routes. It does not visibly specify the PubMedQA/MedMCQA training datasets, so those routes are not supported here.
